prompt:
Four separate square floor textures in a 2 by 2 grid, each filling its own quarter of the image exactly, edge to edge, with a thin plain black line between the quarters. Straight top-down view, flat even lighting with no vignette and no single light spot, so each one can repeat as a game floor tile. Same hand-painted storybook game art style and warm muted palette as the reference image, soft painted edges on every stone, no text, no objects, no characters.
Top left: an old cellar floor of worn grey-brown flagstones with thin dark mortar lines and a few damp darker patches.
Top right: packed earth and flagstones with thin pale tree roots threading between the stones.
Bottom left: wet grey-blue stone slabs with a fine film of silt, faint puddle sheen in the cracks.
Bottom right: warm old fire-brick floor in herringbone, soot-darkened, with a faint orange warmth between the bricks.
